ShortDescription.Value: Design and build editable parks and plazas with custom surfaces, asset mixes and precise placement rules.

Publish.LongDescription:
ParkManager lets you draw park and plaza outlines, mark entrances, choose game assets and preview procedural layouts before building them as editable Cities: Skylines II entities.
**Parks** - Draw and edit a park boundary, then mark its entrances on the outline. - Generate pedestrian paths that follow the shape of the site, narrow or wide, with a selectable ground surface. - Natural planting: groves of varying size and shape, a boundary belt with open views, benches, lamps and bins with separate density controls. - Choose specific vanilla assets or let ParkManager pick a coherent mix; optional fence with automatic entrance gaps. - Park lakes (experimental): a lake in the largest open space, excavated 5 m and filled with water. Can be switched off. - Larger parks get forest animal spawners.
**Plazas** - One centerpiece, a mirrored pair, a set along an axis, or no centerpiece. - Furniture arrangements around the centerpiece or along the boundary, including your own sequence of up to five assets. - Plaza surfaces and an optional fence.
Everything is previewed on the map before building. Built objects are normal game entities and stay editable; each build can be removed as a whole.
**Known issues** - Lakes change the terrain permanently: removing the park removes the water, but the basin stays. Try lakes on a copy of your save first. - Unfinished outlines and previews are not saved with the game.
Source code and bug reports: https://github.com/tomkpunkt/ParkManager
Publish.ChangeLog: New compact top bar replaces the four-step wizard: all settings side by side, one main button for the next step, asset choices in a dropdown below the bar, the lake as a checkbox. Uses the game tooltips and icons; fixes wrapped values and collapsed buttons in the game UI.
